title: Pronunciation practice
subtitle: A short session on the sounds you find hardest. Listen, say it, and get an answer in seconds.

start.hint: The session picks sounds for you: those due for review first, then the ones you slipped on lately. If you are new, it begins with a short check.
start.lowBudget: Your AI allowance is low for a full session ({remaining} of about {estimated} credits left). You can still go on; a session stops when the allowance runs out.
start.chosen: You chose the sound [{family}]; the session practises it.

refused.SESSION_LIMIT: You have done today's sessions. Come back tomorrow.
refused.POOL_EMPTY: The AI allowance for sessions has run out for now.
refused.NOT_AVAILABLE: Pronunciation sessions are not part of your plan.
refused.generic: The session could not start. Try again in a moment.

step.sayPair: Say both words, one after the other
step.noClip: No model clip for this one.

mic.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser and try again.

notice.uploadFailed: The recording did not upload. Try again.
notice.notReady: The recording is not ready yet. Try once more.
notice.inaudible: I could not hear you. Speak a little closer and louder.
notice.tryAgain: That did not work. Try again; this take was not counted.
notice.stale: The session moved on. Here is where you are now.

verdict.unmeasured: Could not tell this time; this take was not counted against you.

tone.other_tone: The melody went the other way.
tone.unsure: Hard to tell the melody; try again.

events.sound_failed: This sound needs more time. See the hint and the lesson, and we will come back to it.
events.side_passed: One word of the pair done.

ending.title: The session is over
ending.body: Hand it in so your progress reaches your cards.
ending.stopped: The session stopped early: your AI allowance ran out. What you did counts.
ending.take_limit: That is the most takes for one session.
ending.retry: Could not hand in. Try again.

result.title: Session result
result.empty: No sound was practised this time.
result.cardsNote: Ratings are on your sound cards now.

broken.title: Something is off with this session
broken.body: Reload it to see where you are.

melody.title: Melody
melody.label: Pitch of your word against the model: yours is solid, the model is dashed.

card.failed: The card could not be loaded.
